2.t: By the Quran, rich in wisdom

3.t: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers

5.t: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful

6.t: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless
6.tr: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon

7.t: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe
7.tr: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon

8.t: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up
8.tr: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon

9.t: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺
9.tr: Wa-ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw wa-min khalfihim saddan fa-aghshai-naahum fahum laa yubsiroon

10.t: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe
10.tr: Wa-sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon

11.t: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder and are in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing Him. So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward
11.tr: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra Wa-khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem

12.t: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record
12.tr: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa Wa-naktubu maa qaddamoo Wa-aasaarahum; Wa-kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen

13.t: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them
13.tr: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon

14.t: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”
14.tr: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimus naini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon

15.t: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”
15.tr: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa Wa-maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon

16.t: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you
16.tr: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon

17.t: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”

18.t: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”
18.tr: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il lam tantahoo lanar-jumannakum Wa-la-yamassan-nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem

19.t: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”
19.tr: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon

20.t: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers
20.tr: Wa-jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluien yas'aa qaala yaa-qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen

21.t: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided
21.tr: Ittabi'oo mal laa yas'alukum ajranw wa-hum muhtadoon

22.t: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned
22.tr: Wa-maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee Wa-ilaihi turja'oon

23.t: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me
23.tr: A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan ien yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril laa tughni 'annee shafaa-'atuhum shai-'anw wa-laa yunqizoon

24.t: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray

25.t: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”

26.t: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew
26.tr: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa-laita qawmee ya'lamoon

27.t: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”
27.tr: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee Wa-ja'alanee minal mukrameen

28.t: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to
28.tr: Wa-maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas samaaa'i Wa-maa kunnaa munzileen

29.t: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once
29.tr: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon

30.t: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked
30.tr: Yaa-hasratan 'alal 'ibaaad; maa ya'teehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi-'oon

31.t: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again
31.tr: Alam yaraw kam ahlak-naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon

32.t: Yet they will all be brought before Us
32.tr: Wa-in kullul lammaa jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon

33.t: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat
33.tr: Wa-Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa Wa-akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu ya'kuloon

34.t: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it
34.tr: Wa-ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw Wa-a'naabinw Wa-fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon

35.t: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks
35.tr: Li-ya'kuloo min samarihee Wa-maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon

36.t: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know
36.tr: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu Wa-min anfusihim Wa-mimmaa laa ya'lamoon

37.t: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness
37.tr: Wa-Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon

38.t: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing
38.tr: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem

39.t: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk
39.tr: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur-joonil qadeem

40.t: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own
40.tr: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara walal lailu saabiqun nahaar; Wa-kullun fee falaki yasbahoon

41.t: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark
41.tr: Wa-Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon

42.t: and created for them similar things to ride in
42.tr: Wa-khalaqnaa lahum mim mislihee maa yarkaboon

43.t: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—
43.tr: Wa-in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum Wa-laa hum yunqazoon

44.t: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while
44.tr: Illaa rahmatam minnaa Wa-mataa'an ilaa heen

45.t: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”
45.tr: Wa-izaa qeela lahumut taqoo maa baina aideekum Wa-maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon

46.t: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it
46.tr: Wa-maa ta'teehim min aayatim min Aayaati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

47.t: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”
47.tr: Wa-izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen

48.t: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
48.tr: Wa-yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

49.t: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes
49.tr: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan ta'khuzuhum Wa-hum yakhissimoon

50.t: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people
50.tr: Falaa yastatee'oona taw-siyatanw wa-laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon

51.t: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord
51.tr: Wa-nufikha fis soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon

52.t: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”
52.tr: Qaaloo yaa-wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu Wa-sadaqal mursaloon

53.t: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us
53.tr: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon

54.t: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do
54.tr: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

55.t: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves
55.tr: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon

56.t: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches
56.tr: Hum Wa-azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon

57.t: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire
57.tr: Lahum feehaa faakiha-tunw wa-lahum maa yadda'oon

58.t: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord

59.t: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones

60.t: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy
60.tr: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

61.t: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path

62.t: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense
62.tr: Wa-laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon

63.t: This is the Hell you were warned of

64.t: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”

65.t: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit
65.tr: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim Wa-tukallimunaaa aideehim Wa-tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

66.t: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see
66.tr: Wa-law nashaaa'u lata-masna 'alaaa aiyyunihim fasta-baqus siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon

67.t: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back
67.tr: Wa-law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon

68.t: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand
68.tr: Wa-man nu-'ammirhu nunakkishu fil khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon

69.t: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran
69.tr: Wa-maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra Wa-maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen

70.t: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers
70.tr: Liyunzira man kaana haiyyanw wa-yahiqqal qawlu 'alal kaafireen

71.t: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control
71.tr: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon

72.t: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others
72.tr: Wa-zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum Wa-minhaa ya'kuloon

73.t: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks
73.tr: Wa-lahum feehaa manaa-fi'u Wa-mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon

74.t: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺
74.tr: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon

75.t: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards
75.tr: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum Wa-hum lahum jundum muhdaroon

76.t: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal
76.tr: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona Wa-maa yu'linoon

77.t: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺
77.tr: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

78.t: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”
78.tr: Wa-daraba lanaa maslanw wa-nasiya khalqahoo qaala maien yuhyil 'izaama Wa-hiya rameem

79.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being
79.tr: Qul yuh-yeehal lazeee ansha-ahaaa awwala marrah; Wa-Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem

80.t: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them
80.tr: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon

81.t: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing
81.tr: Awa-laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa Wa-Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem

82.t: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is
82.tr: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an aien yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon

83.t: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned
83.tr: Fa-Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw wa-ilaihi turja'oon
